items.summary: I am very dissapointed with the new changes. I joined before Saya released and have been playing religiously only to see everything from the most offensive like the affinity changes making it much harder to increase affinity levels and the new difficulty update making all endgame modes p2w checks, and now there's minor adjustments that dont mean anything either. I will not be changing my rating untill it's fixed, and i really hope it does get fixed
